description: This file contains tests for the OpenTelemetry spans and chat completion features using the pytest framework. It tests generating a key, making chat completion requests, retrieving telemetry spans, and verifying their structure and contents.

methods.name: generate_key( session, models=[ "gpt-4", "text-embedding-ada-002", "dall-e-2", "fake-openai-endpoint", "mistral-embed", ], )
methods.description: Asynchronously generates an API key by making a POST request to the key generation endpoint.

methods.name: chat_completion(session, key, model: Union[str, List] = "gpt-4")
methods.description: Performs a chat completion request to a specified model with a generated message.

methods.name: get_otel_spans(session, key)
methods.description: Retrieves OpenTelemetry span data via a GET request.

methods.name: test_chat_completion_check_otel_spans()
methods.description: Main test case that creates a key, makes chat requests, retrieves and analyzes OTEL spans, and performs assertions.

ctags.name: chat_completion
ctags.pattern: /^async def chat_completion(session, key, model: Union[str, List] = "gpt-4"):$/
